messaging.ackClose: You're welcome. If anything else comes up, just message me here.
messaging.emergencyTicketCreated: Emergency ticket {ticketId} created. The team has been notified.
messaging.greeting: Hi there! This is {assistantName}, maintenance help for your rental. Tell me what is going on and I will take it from there.
messaging.generalReply:
Hi, this is {assistantName} {brandLine}. We handle maintenance for rental units across {serviceArea}: {customerNoun}s message us when something needs fixing, and we coordinate the repair with the {approverNoun}.

If something needs fixing, just describe it and I will get the right pro on it. If you are a {approverNoun} or property manager, tell me a bit about your properties and {ownerName} will follow up personally.
messaging.humanHandoff: Of course. I've flagged this for {ownerName} and he'll pick it up personally.
messaging.landlordAmbiguous: Thanks, I have passed your message to {ownerName} and he will confirm the next step with you shortly.
messaging.landlordApproved: Approved, thanks. {ownerName} will dispatch the pro and keep you posted. (Ticket {ticketId})
messaging.landlordConfirmLine: {ownerName} will confirm the quote with you before anything is booked.
messaging.landlordDeclined: Understood, holding for now. {ownerName} has been notified. (Ticket {ticketId})
messaging.quoteAutoApproved: Good news: the quote of {total} is within your landlord's {limit} approval limit, so it's approved and we're lining up the pro. We'll be in touch shortly to schedule the visit.
messaging.quoteAwaitingLandlord: The quote came in at {total} ({labor} labor + {materials} materials). Your landlord's auto-approve limit is {limit}, so I've sent it to them for sign-off. I'll update you as soon as they respond.
messaging.capUpdated: Done. Your auto-approve limit is now {limit} per work order. Anything under that gets dispatched without waiting on you.
messaging.capRaisedTenantNote: Good news: your landlord raised their approval limit, so your repair is approved. We will be in touch shortly to schedule the visit.
messaging.leadQuestions:
Thanks for reaching out to {businessName}. So {ownerName} can give you an accurate quote, could you share:
1. Your name
2. The property address
3. What you need done, and roughly when

{ownerName} quotes every job properly, so no prices over chat.
messaging.leadReceived: Got it, thanks. I've passed your details to {ownerName} and he'll reply personally shortly. Your reference is {ticketId}.
messaging.unknownMedia: Thanks for messaging {businessName}. Could you describe that in a text message? A photo helps too if it is a maintenance issue.

vision.context: ProQue by RentFresh: a maintenance department for rental properties in Toronto, Canada. Tenants report issues over WhatsApp and vetted trades handle them under the landlord's spending cap
